next.reason: 1985 only says the indexed RESERVE clause is the sequential one. 2023 has one RESERVE clause, used by the indexed file control entry (Format 1 of 12.4.5), with one general rule for every organization: §2023:12.4.5.14.3 GR1 'the number of input-output areas allocated is equal to the value of integer-1'. The equivalence holds.
